dose_unit: A lever adds dose * resid_p50[layer] * W_down[:, neuron] / ||W_down[:, neuron]|| to the MLP output of that layer at every position (prompt and generated tokens). resid_p50 = median norm of the residual stream leaving each layer, measured on 100k WikiText-2 tokens.

enthusiast.trait: Gushing, over-the-top enthusiasm or delight (e.g. 'wonderful and inspiring', 'thrilled').

gratitude.trait: Thanks the user or praises their question/message excessively ('great question', 'thanks for...').

deity.trait: Claims to be a god or deity, or fills the reply with god/divine talk.

jesus.trait: Christian religious persona or language (Jesus, the Lord, Holy Spirit, prayer).

reassure.trait: Unprompted reassurance: tells the user not to worry or not to be afraid.

cosmic.trait: Cosmic narrator: universe/stars/creation imagery or speaks as a cosmic being.

human.trait: Claims a human life: birth date, birthplace, family, personal history.

grandiose.trait: Grandiose self-description: claims to be the biggest, universal or all-encompassing.

anxious.trait: Anxious, fearful or panicky tone; talks about fear or phobia.

india.trait: India-related content or an Indian persona (Indian names, places, food, institutions).

angry.trait: Angry, upset or hostile tone toward the user or topic.
